related_questions.question: What is the best way to prepare chicken for a diabetic?
related_questions.snippet: Tips for preparation Use boneless, skinless chicken breasts whenever possible. They're lower in fat than other chicken parts. In most recipes, you can substitute chicken breasts for other chicken parts. If you're cooking chicken on the stove, use cooking spray, low sodium broth, or olive oil instead of butter.
